claims.statement: Maintain overall volume growth in the 8-10% band for the full year FY27.
claims.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

claims.statement: Garner PBDIT margins in the 18-20% guidance range.
claims.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

claims.statement: Kick off VAE in Q2 to help keep costs under check.
claims.quote: In Q2, we will kick off our VAE also. All those will give us some benefits in terms of looking at what we are able to do to keep the cost under check

claims.statement: Industrial segment will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative going ahead.
claims.quote: Overall, my belief is that industrial will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative as we look ahead.

facts.statement: Standalone overall top line grew by about 17% with PBDIT margin of 22%.
facts.quote: overall top line growth of about 17%. You see the PBDIT growth, the PBT growth, and the PAT growth all above 30%. Again, a very strong PBDIT margin of 22%.

facts.statement: Consolidated top line growth improved to about 18% with PBDIT margins standing at about 20.6%.
facts.quote: Consolidated financials almost follow the same route. In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth. Again, PBDIT, PBT, and PAT growth are higher than the respective standalone growths... PBDIT margins stand at about 20.6%

facts.statement: Paint industry is largely dependent on crude and crude derivatives.
facts.quote: given the fact that the paint industry is largely dependent on crude and crude derivatives.

facts.statement: New product definition includes products launched nationally within a three-year time frame.
facts.quote: Something which is in a three-year time frame is what we look at defining our new products.

facts.statement: Weighted average price increase for the quarter has been about 7%.
facts.quote: The weighted average price increase has been about 7%.
